# Roleplay Rule 9 - Central Command Dignitary Rules
[color=#1e7f28][bold]Central Command Dignitaries[/bold][/color], which are the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Nanotrasen Representative[/bold][/color] (NTR) and the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Blueshield Officer[/bold][/color] (BSO), are held to a very high standard of roleplay. Nanotrasen would be very selective with whom they choose as their company’s representatives and personal bodyguards. Your roleplay should represent this.
Refer to the NTR and BSO’s Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) guidebook entries for job duties. - [textlink="Nanotrasen Representative SOP" link="NanotrasenRepSOP"] - [textlink="Blueshield Officer SOP" link="BlueshieldOfficerSOP"]
## Precedents
- Neither the NTR nor BSO are higher in a position than [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color]; they are a third party and have no power or say over station affairs unless otherwise ordered by [color=#1e7f28][bold]Central Command[/bold][/color].
